description: One edition of the Builders in Fintech daily digest (weekdays): the equity rounds that became public in its window (largest first within USD, EUR, GBP, then other currencies; never converted), news published in the window, one upcoming event and any podcast episode. Arguments: date (optional, 'YYYY-MM-DD'); omit for the latest published edition. Only published editions are returned. Unknown arguments are rejected.

date.description: Edition date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Omit for the latest.

name: get_daily_digest
title: Get a daily digest edition
